source: Telemedicine Practice Guidelines 2020 (MoHFW/NMC): drugs in Schedule X and narcotic or psychotropic substances under the NDPS Act may not be prescribed by teleconsultation. Anti-cancer drugs are excluded on the clinical lead's instruction (3 Nov call).
refillAdvice: Narcotic medicines such as morphine are refilled at the patient's registered hospital (a Recognised Medical Institution).
